blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Target Language Extraction (TLE) aims to isolate speech in a target language from multilingual mixtures. Existing approaches primarily rely on acoustic modeling with language identity labels, which provide only coarse categorical guidance. In this work, we propose a language-oriented semantic modeling framework that augments acoustic extraction with language-specific semantic representations. A pre-trained speech semantic model is adapted via language-aware prompt conditioning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning to generate target-language-focused semantic representations from the mixture. {These capture high-level semantic structure of the acoustics and they} are integrated into the extraction model to provide structured semantic guidance beyond identity labels. Experiments on the CommonVoiceMix dataset show that incorporating semantic representations consistently improves over acoustic-only baselines, achieving up to 1.16 dB SI-SDR gain.
blocks.zh: 目标语言提取(TLE)旨在将目标语言中的言语与多种语言的混合物隔离开来. 现有方法主要依靠带有语言身份标签的声学模型,这只提供了粗糙的绝对指导. 在这部作品中,我们提出了一个面向语言的语义模型化框架,用语言特有的语义表达来增强声学提取. 通过语言意识的即时调制和参数效率高的微调来调整预训语义模型,生成来自混合物的目标语言重点语义表现. {这些捕捉声学的高级语义结构和它们}被整合到提取模型中,以提供除身份标签以外的结构化语义指导. 在CommonVoiceMix数据集上的实验显示,纳入语义表达比仅声学基线持续改善,实现最高1.16 dB SI-SDR增益.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: An auditory landscape often contains signals from multiple sources. Humans have the remarkable ability to selectively attend to a single source while suppressing others defined as the Cocktail Party Problem [ 5 ] . Replicating this in machines is crucial as a pre-processing step for downstream single-source applications, yet isolating specific signals from multi-source mixtures still poses a great challenge.
blocks.zh: 一个听觉景观往往包含来自多个来源的信号. 人类有显著的能力有选择地关注单一来源,同时压制被定义为"鸡尾酒党问题"的其他人. [5]. 作为下游单源应用程序的预处理步骤,在机器中复制这种信号至关重要,但从多源混合物中分离特定信号仍构成巨大挑战。

blocks.en: The extraction process requires an auxiliary cue to define the target source. Target Speaker Extraction (TSE) typically uses a voiceprint as the cue that is obtained from an enrollment utterance by the target speaker [ 8 , 30 , 33 , 32 , 10 ] . Other effective cues include text prompts about the speaker [ 11 , 6 ] or the content [ 14 ] , visual cues such as facial images [ 23 ] , facial videos [ lookingtolisten ] or lip movements [ 17 ] and even contextual history [ 15 ] or EEG signals [ 9 , 7 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 提取过程需要一个辅助提示来定义目标源. 目标扬声器提取(TSE)通常使用语音印作为从目标扬声器的入场讲话中获取的提示[8、30、33、32、10]。 其他有效的提示包括:关于扬声器的文字提示[11,6]或内容[14],视觉提示如面部图像[23],面部视频[期待倾听]或唇动[17],甚至连背景历史[15]或EEG信号[9,7,22].

blocks.en: A similar scenario arises in multilingual environments where speech is extracted based on the spoken language, i.e. the language serves as the cue. This presents itself commonly in international environments such as airports and academic conferences. Unlike the practically infinite variability of individual speakers, languages are governed by finite and unique phonotactic, syntactic and linguistic characteristics that can be explicitly modeled. In addition, downstream models for a specific language are specialized on this unique nature. As such, it is crucial to separate audio mixtures into individual languages. This is called Target Language Extraction (TLE) first introduced in [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 类似的情况发生在多语种环境中,根据口语提取语言,即语言作为提示. 这在诸如机场和学术会议等国际环境中是常见的。 与个别讲者实际上无穷无尽的变异性不同,语言受到可以明确模型化的有限和独特的光学,合成和语言特征的支配. 此外,特定语言的下游模型也专门研究这种独特的性质. 因此,将音频混合物分离成个别语言至关重要。 这被称为目标语言提取(TLE),最早引入于[2].

blocks.en: TLE has been studied in a limited scope. Previous works [ 4 , 3 ] adapted TSE architectures for TLE such as ConvTasNet [ 18 ] , Spex+ [ 10 ] , Sepformer [ 26 ] which primarily operate on acoustic features to perform the extraction in a latent space. These acoustic-centric approaches fail to exploit the higher-level semantic structure of the underlying language.
blocks.zh: TLE的研究范围有限. 之前的作品[4,3]为TLE改造了TESE架构,如ConvTasNet[18],Spex+[10],Sepformer[26],这些架构主要在声学特性上操作,在潜伏空间中进行提取. 这些以声学为中心的方法未能利用基础语言的更高层次语义结构.

blocks.en:
[ psychology1 ] shows that the encoding of natural language in the human cognitive system is affected significantly by the semantic expectation of the listener. Moreover, semantic context helps listeners sharpen their comprehension in noisy environments [ biology1 ] enhancing their understanding.
Motivated by this, we propose to incorporate high-level structural representations into the TLE pipeline to guide the extraction.
blocks.zh:
[心理学1]显示人类认知系统中自然语言的编码受到听者语义期望的重大影响. 此外,语义背景有助于听众在吵闹的环境中加深理解[生物学1]增强理解.
为此,我们建议将高级别结构表述纳入TLE管道,以指导提取工作。

blocks.en: Recent advances in large language models provide access to more fine-grained semantic representations. These architectures model the deep semantic relationships in a language which can be leveraged for different speech tasks such as speech enhancement [ li2025saslm ] , speech emotion recognition [ 19 ] or generative TSE [ 29 ] . More directly, language models have been applied to cocktail-party tasks, e.g. LauraTSE [ 28 ] for target speaker extraction and MT-LLM [ 21 ] for multi-talker transcription. Unlike these, which use the language model as the extraction engine itself, we employ it as semantic guidance for a separate acoustic backbone. However, the integration of discrete semantic priors into the extraction pipelines remains unexplored.
blocks.zh: 近期在大语言模型上的进步提供了更精细的语义表达方式. 这些架构将深层语义关系建模在一个语言中,这种语言可以用于语音增强[li2025saslm],语音情感识别[19]或基因TSE[29]等不同的语音任务. 更直接地说,语言模型被应用于鸡尾酒派对任务,例如:用于目标扬声器提取的LaratSE[28]和用于多语言者转录的MT-LLM[21]. 与使用语言模型作为提取引擎本身的这些不同,我们使用它作为单独的声学骨干的语义指导. 然而,将离散语义学前科纳入提炼管道的问题仍未得到探讨。

blocks.en:
We propose a language-oriented semantic modeling approach where a large speech model is trained to predict clean semantic tokens from multilingual mixtures via language-specific prompt-conditioning and injecting them into the language extraction pipeline to guide the extraction. Context tokens for different languages condition the large speech model to generate semantic tokens for the specific target language.
Unlike [ 31 ] , which guides extraction using coarse language-identity cues with a dedicated model per language, we integrate generated semantic tokens into a single shared TLE pipeline that operates on the acoustic space, providing structured guidance beyond categorical language choice.
Experiments on the CommonVoiceMix [ 31 ] show that this approach improves the extraction quality over the baseline by up to 1.16 dB SI-SDR.
blocks.zh:
我们提出一种面向语言的语义模型方法,即训练一个大型的语音模型,通过语言专用的即时空调来预测来自多语言混合物的清洁语义符号,并将它们注入语言提取管道,以引导提取. 不同语言的上下文符号将大型语音模型作为条件,生成特定目标语言的语义符号.
与[31]不同,我们用粗糙的语言识别提示用每个语言的专用模型来引导提取,我们把生成的语义符号整合到一个在声学空间上运行的单一共享的TLE管道中,提供结构化的指导,超越绝对的语言选择.
在通用VoiceMix [31]上的实验表明,这种方法比基准提高提取质量,最高可达1.16 dB SI-SDR.

blocks.en: Figure 1: The general overview of the proposed approach. The left half is the language-oriented semantic modeling via generic speech semantic model converted into a language-focused semantic extractor via prompt conditioning and parameter-efficient adaptation. The generated semantic tokens are incorporated into the baseline extraction architecture via cross-attention on the right half. L2 means language 2 present in the mixture.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 拟议办法的总体概况。 左半部分是语言导向语义模型,通过通用语义模型通过即时条件和参数高效的适应转换成语言聚焦语义提取器. 生成的语义符号通过在右半边的交叉刻录,被纳入基线提取架构. L2指混合物中存在的语言2.

blocks.en: To sum up, our contributions are: • We propose a language-oriented semantic adaptation framework for Target Language Extraction, where a pretrained speech semantic model is conditioned via prompt design and LoRA fine-tuning to produce target-language-focused semantic representations from multilingual mixtures. • We incorporate the predicted semantic tokens into the separation model to guide extraction with language-structured semantic information beyond coarse language identity labels. • Through systematic ablation studies, we demonstrate that language identity labels provide categorical constraints while semantic representations offer structural guidance, and their combination yields the best performance. • We validate the proposed language-oriented semantic modeling on CommonVoiceMix, achieving up to 1.16 dB SI-SDR improvement over a strong TLE baseline.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的贡献是: 我们提出目标语言提取语言语义调整框架,通过即时设计和LORA微调对语言语义模型进行预先培训,以便从多种语言混合物中产生以语言为重点的语义表述。 我们把预测的语义符号纳入分离模型中,以语言结构的语义信息指导提取,超越粗糙的语言身份标签. • 我们通过有系统的消化研究,表明语言身份标签提供了绝对的限制,而语义表述则提供了结构指导,其组合产生最佳效果。 我们验证了在CommonVoiceMix上提议的面向语言的语义模型,比一个强大的TLE基线实现最高1.16 dB SI-SDR改进.

blocks.en: We propose a language-oriented semantic adaptation framework for Target Language Extraction, where a pretrained speech semantic model is conditioned via prompt design and LoRA fine-tuning to produce target-language-focused semantic representations from multilingual mixtures.
blocks.zh: 我们为《目标语言提取》提出了一个面向语言的语义调整框架,通过迅速设计和LORA微调,对经过预先培训的语义模型加以限定,以便从多种语言混合物中产生以语言为重点的语义表述。

blocks.en: We incorporate the predicted semantic tokens into the separation model to guide extraction with language-structured semantic information beyond coarse language identity labels.
blocks.zh: 我们把预测的语义符号纳入分离模型中,以语言结构的语义信息指导提取,超越粗糙的语言身份标签.

blocks.en: Through systematic ablation studies, we demonstrate that language identity labels provide categorical constraints while semantic representations offer structural guidance, and their combination yields the best performance.
blocks.zh: 通过系统的消化研究,我们表明语言身份标签提供了绝对的制约,而语义表达则提供了结构指导,其组合产生最佳的性能.

blocks.en: We validate the proposed language-oriented semantic modeling on CommonVoiceMix, achieving up to 1.16 dB SI-SDR improvement over a strong TLE baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们验证了在CommonVoiceMix上提议的面向语言的语义模型,比一个强大的TLE基线实现最高1.16 dB SI-SDR改进.

blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: The backbone for the TLE baseline is based on the Sepformer [ 26 ] architecture. As displayed in the right half of Figure 1 , the encoder transforms the mixture waveform into the latent embeddings. A one-hot vector representing the target language identity is concatenated to the mixture embeddings along the feature dimension, providing the necessary conditioning for the extraction process. Subsequently, these embeddings are processed by a dual-path transformer network which alternately models the local dependencies via the intra-transformer and the global dependencies via the inter-transformer, producing a final extraction mask. The masked embeddings are decoded to reconstruct the estimated monolingual waveform. The loss function is computed between the estimated and the ground-truth monolingual target signals in the time domain.
blocks.zh: TLE基线的主干基于Sepforce [26] 架构. 如图1右半部所示,编码器将混合物波形转化为潜伏的嵌入体. 代表目标语言特性的一热矢量被混凝土沿特征维度嵌入,为提取过程提供必要的条件. 随后,这些嵌入物由双路径变压器网络进行处理,该网络通过内部变压器对本地的依赖性进行模型化,通过内部变压器对全球的依赖性进行模型化,产生最终的提取罩. 蒙面嵌入器被解码以重建估计的单语言波形. 损失函数是在估计值和时间域的地面真实的单一语言目标信号之间计算的。

blocks.en: 2.2 Language-Oriented Semantic Modeling
blocks.zh: 2.2 语言导向语义模型

blocks.en: The proposed approach adopts a semantic-aware speech language model [ li2025saslm ] as the backbone for language-oriented semantic modeling. During training, an audio encoder processes the mixture signal to obtain audio embeddings denoted in red in Figure 1 . Similarly, a semantic-aware tokenizer processes the clean target speech waveform to acquire discrete tokens that encode high-level, semantically-rich acoustic structure learned through large-scale pretraining, rather than low-level spectral features. We refer to these as semantic tokens throughout and they are denoted in purple in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 提议的方法采用语义感知语言模型[li2025saslm]作为面向语言的语义模型的骨干. 在训练期间,一个音频编码器处理混合物信号,以获得图1中红色表示的音频嵌入。 同样,一种语义感知器会处理干净的目标语音波形,以获得离散的符号,这些符号通过大规模预训而不是低水平的光谱特征来编码高水平,精密丰富的声学结构. 我们把这些当作语义符号,在图1中以紫色表示。

blocks.en: Context tokens displayed in blue are used to combine these two sequences into a single input sequence for the language model. Start and end tokens are used to signify the start and the end. In addition, a language identity token is inserted between the audio embeddings and the semantic tokens. This represents the transition from the multilingual mixture embeddings to monolingual clean tokens. Moreover, this language token is chosen from a bank of possible language identity tokens containing one per supported language. This conditions the model to generate the tokens for the chosen language. The resulting input sequence is formatted as ” < < start > > , mixture embeddings, < < language > > , clean semantic tokens, < < end > > ”. The main diagram in Figure 1 displays the case for L2 without loss of generality.
blocks.zh: 以蓝色显示的上下文符号用于将这两个序列组合成语言模型的单一输入序列. 始末符号用于表示始末. 此外,在音频嵌入和语义符号之间插入一个语言身份符号. 这代表了从多语种混合嵌入物向单一语言清洁物的过渡. 此外,这种语言符号是从一个可能包含每个支持语言一个语言身份符号库中选择的. 这为模型为所选语言生成符号提供了条件. 所产生的输入序列格式为 " < start > > 、混合嵌入、 < 语言 > 、干净的语义符号、 < 结束 > " 。 图1中的主图显示了L2的例,没有失去通俗性.

blocks.en: The language model takes the mixture embeddings and the language token as a prefix and autoregressively predicts the probability distribution for the next token given all previous tokens. The training objective is the cross-entropy loss over the predicted semantic token positions while outputs corresponding to mixture embeddings and control tokens are ignored. The predicted semantic tokens are denoted in orange, whereas the irrelevant outputs are uncolored.
blocks.zh: 语言模型将混合嵌入和语言符号作为前缀,并自动地预测了鉴于之前所有的符号,下一个符号的概率分布. 培训目标是在预测的语义符号位置上出现交叉性损失,而与混合嵌入和控制符号相应的产出则被忽视。 预测的语义符号以橙色表示,而无关的输出则无色.

blocks.en: During inference, the clean speech waveform is not accessible. Semantic tokens are generated auto-regressively starting with the prompt ” < < start token > > , mixture embeddings, < < language token > > ” until the model predicts the < < end > > token.
blocks.zh: 推论期间,清净的语音波形是不可访问的. 语义符号是自动递归式生成的,起始于即时“ < start sorder > ,混合嵌入, < 语言sorder > > ,直到模型预测 < end > 符号.

blocks.en: 2.3 Injection of Semantic Information
blocks.zh: 2.3 语义信息注射

blocks.en: The generated semantic embeddings provide language-structured semantic guidance and they are integrated into the extraction baseline. A linear projection layer maps the semantic tokens to the latent dimensionality of the extraction encoder, aligning them with the acoustic embedding space. Subsequently, they are injected before the extractor via a cross attention block after the one-hot embedding concatenation. The acoustic mixture embeddings serve as queries, while the semantic tokens act as keys and values. A residual connection around the attention block enables the fusion of semantic information with the acoustic representations, resulting in semantically informed acoustic features. Together with the one-hot language embedding, the extractor is conditioned to leverage semantic information during latent-space extraction. The remaining operations follow the baseline described in Section 2.1 .
blocks.zh: 生成的语义嵌入提供了语言结构的语义指导,它们被整合到提取基线中. 一个线性投影层将语义符号映射到提取编码器的潜在维度上,使其与声学嵌入空间一致. 随后,它们在提取器之前通过单热嵌入凝固后通过交叉注意力块注入. 辅音混合物嵌入物作为查询,而语义符号则起到键和值的作用. 注意力块周围的剩余连接使得语义信息能够与声素表达体融合,从而形成精密知情的声学特征. 与一热语言嵌入一起,提取器在潜在空间提取时被附加条件,以杠杆化语义信息. 其余业务遵循第2.1节所述的基线。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: The baseline architecture is based on the Sepformer [ 26 ] implemented in Speechbrain 1 1 1 https://github.com/speechbrain/speechbrain with the default parameters and a single mask. The loss function is the standard Scale-invariant Signal-to-Distortion Ratio (SI-SDR) [ 16 ] . The model is trained on the CommonVoiceMix dataset introduced in [ 31 ] consisting of mixtures obtained from English and German utterances from the CommonVoice dataset [ ardilaCommonVoiceMassivelyMultilingual2020 ] . We use an AdamW optimizer with an initial learning rate of 3 ⋅ 10 − 4 3\cdot{10}^{-4} . The first 10 epochs serve as a warmup phase where the learning rate is increased linearly until the initial value at the 10th epoch. Afterwards, the learning rate is halved if the validation SI-SDR does not improve for three epochs. Training is terminated if the validation performance does not improve for 20 consecutive epochs.
blocks.zh: 基线架构基于Spectbrain 1 1 1 https://github.com/speechbrain/speechbrain中执行的Sepforce [26],带有默认参数和一个面具. 损失函数为标准比例尺-内变信号对扭曲比(SI-SDR)[16]. 该模型在[31]引入的通用VoiceMix数据集上进行了培训,该数据集由来自通用Voice数据集[ardilaCommonVoiceMassively Multilanic 2020]的英语和德语语音的混合物组成。 我们使用 AdamW 优化器, 初始学习率为 3 — 10 – 4 3\cdot{ 10 — 4} 。 前10个纪元作为暖化阶段,学习率线性提高,直到第10个纪元的初始值. 之后,如果验证 SI-SDR 不改进三个纪元,学习率将减半。 如果验证性能连续20个纪元未改善,则终止培训。

blocks.en: The speech language model is a Llama-based architecture. We use the pretrained model from [ li2025saslm ] trained on the Emilia dataset [ 12 ] . Similarly, the audio encoder is Whisper [ 24 ] and the tokenizer is the S3-Tokenizer [ 1 ] . This allows the model to leverage semantic representations learned from large-scale pretraining. This is a large model and it is costly to train in its entirety. We apply LoRA [ 13 ] for parameter-efficient fine-tuning [ 20 ] for the attention blocks, specifically the Q and V projection matrices. We initialize the weights from the pretrained model 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/ASLP-lab/SenSE and train with Adam optimizer with an initial learning rate of 3 ⋅ 10 − 4 3\cdot{10}^{-4} . The learning rate is decreased by 1% after every epoch. The language-specific prompt tokens are initialized with the < < Turn of Speech > > token and then learned independently from each other for each language. The cross-attention module used for semantic injection is a multi-head attention block with 8 heads. The semantic model is trained separately first, followed by the training of the proposed extraction module.
blocks.zh: 语音语言模型是一个基于Llama的建筑. 我们使用[li2025saslm]的预训模型 在艾米利亚数据集受训 [12]. 同样,音频编码器是Whisper [24],代号是S3-Tokenizer [1]. 这使得模型能够利用从大规模预训中吸取的语义表现. 这是一个大型模式,培训费用很高。 我们为注意区块,特别是Q和V投影矩阵,应用LORA[13]进行参数效率微调[20]. 我们从预训模式2 2 2 开始初始化权重 https://huggingface.co/ASLP-lab/SenSE 并使用亚当优化器进行训练,初始学习率为 3 → 10 − 4 → 3\cdot{10}^{-4}. 在每个时代之后,学习率下降1%。 语言专用的即时符号以 " 语音转折 " 符号初始化,然后为每种语言独立学习。 用于语义注射的交叉注意力模块是一个多头注意力块,有8个头. 语义模型首先单独培训,然后培训拟议的提取模块。

blocks.en: The full semantic model comprises approximately 1.1 B parameters, dominated by the frozen audio encoder and the Llama backbone. Only 14.0 M parameters ( ≈ \approx 1.3% of the total) are trainable. This keeps the adaptation cost modest despite the large backbone. The inference is done in a greedy fashion with a hard limit on maximum number of tokens.
blocks.zh: 全语义模型包含大约1.1 B参数,以冷冻的音频编码器和Llama主干器为主. 仅14.0 M参数(QQ\\\大约占总数的1.3%)是可训练的. 尽管有大型骨干,但适应费用仍然较低。 推论是以贪婪的方式进行的,对最高的代币数量有严格的限制.

blocks.en: 3.2 Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 结果

blocks.en: The main results compare the baseline model without the semantic tokens to the proposed approach incorporating semantic guidance. The results are presented in Table 1 . In addition to the SI-SDR values, we also present the STOI [ 27 ] and PESQ [ 25 ] performance. SI-SDR measures the signal reconstruction fidelity whereas STOI and PESQ indicate the objective intelligibility and perceptual quality respectively.
blocks.zh: 主要结果将基线模型(没有语义符号)与纳入语义指导的拟议方法进行比较。 调查结果见表1。 除了SI-SDR值外,我们还展示了STOI[27]和PESQ[25]性能. SI-SDR测量信号重建的忠诚度,而STOI和PESQ分别显示客观的知觉和知觉质量。

blocks.en: The approach guided by the semantic tokens outperforms the baseline across all metrics. There is a consistent improvement of 1.27 dB and 1.16 dB on the validation and test sets, respectively, with absolute values consistent with the baseline reported on the same data in [ 31 ] . This indicates that the semantic tokens provide informative contextual guidance that enhances the extraction of the target language.
blocks.zh: 语义符号所指引的方法超越了所有指标的基线。 在审定和测试组上分别有1.27 dB和1.16 dB的不断改进,绝对值与[31]中同一数据报告的基准一致。 这表明语义符号提供了信息化的语境指导,加强了目标语言的提取.

blocks.en: Table 1: Extraction performance with/without semantic tokens. ↑ \uparrow means higher is better.
blocks.zh: 表1:有/无语义符号的提取性能。 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}太过份了意味着更高了

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Results for each language
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 每种语文的结果

blocks.en: Dataset distributions are frequently imbalanced across languages. Widely spoken languages such as English and Mandarin typically have more training data available. The pretraining was performed on the Emilia dataset [ 12 ] that has 46800 hours of English speech and only 1600 hours of German speech. To investigate if this imbalance leads to biased representations that favor English, we present the results separated by the target language in Table 2 . We see that the semantic tokens improve SI-SDR by 1.17 dB and 1.14 dB for English and German, respectively. The performance gains for both languages are similar. This indicates that the semantic tokens provide effective contextual guidance for both English and German. This supports the robustness of our approach suggesting that the proposed approach generalizes beyond high-resource languages and remains effective even when pretraining data is limited.
blocks.zh: 数据集的分布往往在各种语言之间不平衡。 英语和普通话等广泛使用的语言通常有更多的培训数据。 预训是在埃米利亚数据集[12]上进行的,该数据集有46800小时的英语语音,只有1600小时的德语语音. 为了调查这种不平衡是否导致偏向英文的表述,我们提出表2中的目标语言分开的结果。 我们看到语义符号分别将英语和德语的SI-SDR改进1.17 dB和1.14 dB. 两种语言的性能增益相似. 这表明语义符号为英语和德语提供了有效的背景指导. 这支持我们的做法的稳健性,它表明,拟议的做法超越了高资源语言,即使在培训前数据有限的情况下仍然有效。

blocks.en: We additionally compare against [ 31 ] , which trains a dedicated expert model per language on the same train/dev/test split. Our proposed approach outperforms these per-language experts on SI-SDR for both languages, despite using a single shared model rather than one expert per language. The gains are consistent across STOI as well, with a marginal exception on English PESQ where the two methods are comparable.
blocks.zh: 我们与[31]进行额外比较,后者在同一列火车/dev/测试分机上培训每个语言的专门专家模型。 我们提议的办法在两种语言的SI-SDR上都比这些每语言的专家要好,尽管使用一种共享模式,而不是每语言一名专家。 除了两种方法具有可比性的英文PESQ之外,整个STOI的收益也是一致的。

blocks.en: Table 2: Results for each language on test set. ↑ \uparrow means higher is better.
blocks.zh: 表2:测试集中每种语言的结果。 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}那么高就更好了 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}那就更简单了

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Ablation of language choice with one-hot embedding
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 采用一热嵌入方式选择语言

blocks.en: The baseline model relies on the one-hot embedding to specify which language to extract whereas the proposed approach has access to both the one-hot embedding and the semantic tokens. To investigate if the semantic tokens from the target language are enough for the model to determine the target language, we conducted the experiment without the one-hot embedding and with only the semantic tokens. The results are presented in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 基准模型依靠一热嵌入来指定要提取的语言,而拟议方法既可以获取一热嵌入语和语义符号。 为了调查来自目标语言的语义符号是否足以使模型确定目标语言,我们进行了实验,没有单热嵌入,只使用语义符号. 调查结果见表3。

blocks.en: Providing semantic tokens alone yields results inferior to the baseline, suggesting that these tokens lack the discriminative power to disambiguate the target source without categorical identity labels. A plausible explanation is that, without the explicit language identity input, the model may fail to reliably determine the target language and occasionally extract speech from the interfering source, leading to degraded performance. This indicates that explicit language identity conditioning remains essential, while semantic tokens provide complementary fine-grained contextual guidance. This aligns with the expectation that the semantic tokens provide semantic information only.
blocks.zh: 仅提供语义符号就产生低于基线的结果,这表明这些符号缺乏歧视力量,无法在不带有明确身份标签的情况下将目标源分化。 一个合理的解释是,如果没有明确的语言身份输入,模型可能无法可靠地确定目标语言,偶尔从干扰源提取语音,导致性能退化. 这表明,明确的语言特征条件仍然至关重要,而语义符号则提供了补充性精细背景指导。 这符合语义符号只提供语义信息的期望.

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation of the one-hot language embedding. ↑ \uparrow means higher is better.
blocks.zh: 表3:一热语言嵌入的缩写. {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}那么高就更好了 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}那就更简单了

blocks.en: 3.2.3 Contradictory Language Input
blocks.zh: 3.2.3 矛盾语言输入

blocks.en: Previous results suggest that the semantic tokens are not sufficient and the target language choice remains crucial. To verify that the main choice of the target language is governed by the one-hot embedding, we evaluate configurations where either the one-hot embedding or the semantic tokens are replaced with those corresponding to the interfering language as seen in Table 4 . Contradictory conditioning leads to severe degradation, as the model is encouraged to extract the interfering language instead of the target. Notably, reversing the one-hot embedding while keeping the semantic tokens correct results in catastrophic degradation indicating that the one-hot embedding exerts dominant control over language selection. The results confirm that the explicit one-hot embedding serves as the primary gating mechanism while the semantic tokens act in complementary capacity. However, incorrect semantic tokens still cause a clear degradation showing that their contribution is still essential.
blocks.zh: 以往的结果表明语义符号不够,目标语言选择仍然至关重要. 为了验证目标语言的主要选择是由单热嵌入来规范,我们评价配置,即将单热嵌入或语义符号替换为表4所示干扰语言对应的配置. 矛盾条件导致严重退化,因为鼓励模型提取干扰语言而不是目标. 值得注意的是,扭转一热嵌入,同时保持语义符号正确无误地造成灾难性退化,表明一热嵌入对语言选择具有主导性控制。 结果证实,明确的一热嵌入是主要引子机制,而语义符号则发挥补充作用。 然而,错误的语义符号仍然导致明显的退化,表明它们的贡献仍然至关重要。

blocks.en: Table 4: Contradictory language input results. ↑ \uparrow means higher is better. ✓ \checkmark means correct language input whereas ⇌ \rightleftharpoons means mismatched language conditioning
blocks.zh: 表4:矛盾的语言输入结果。 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}太过份了意味着更高了 \\\ checkmark 表示正确的语言输入,而\\\\ 右侧的harpoons 表示不匹配的语言条件

blocks.en: 3.2.4 Smaller models
blocks.zh: 3.2.4 小型型号

blocks.en: Smaller architectures often lack the modeling capacity to capture complex acoustic-only feature mappings from limited data. Therefore, smaller models may benefit from the integration of the semantic information more. We test this by halving the size of the extraction model, i.e. setting N t = 4 N_{t}=4 instead of N t = 8 N_{t}=8 in Figure 1 . Table 5 summarizes the performance of the smaller model. Notably, the performance gain increases to 1.6 dB for the smaller model, a notable jump compared to the 1.16 dB gain observed for the original variant. This suggests a promising paradigm for resource-constrained edge applications, where a compact extraction backbone is enhanced by high-fidelity semantic representations from a larger, potentially shared, language model.
blocks.zh: 较小的架构往往缺乏模型制作能力,无法从有限的数据中捕捉到复杂的唯声特征绘图. 因此,较小的模型可能更多受益于语义信息的整合. 我们通过将提取模型的大小减半来测试,即在图1中设置 N t = 4 N_{t}=4,而不是 N t = 8 N_{t}=8. 表5总结了较小模式的绩效。 值得注意的是,较小的模型的性能增益增加到1.6 dB,与原变体观察到的1.16 dB增益相比,这是一个显著的跳跃. 这表明,在资源有限的边缘应用方面,一个很有希望的范例是,通过一个更大的、可能共享的语言模型的高纯度语义表述,加强紧凑的提取主干。

blocks.en: Table 5: Results for the model with half the size, i.e. N t = 4 N_{t}=4 . ↑ \uparrow means higher is better.
blocks.zh: 表5:大小一半的模型结果,即Nt = 4 N_{t}=4。\ oparrow 表示较高更好。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: This work presented a novel framework that bridges the gap between low-level acoustic signal processing and high-level semantic speech representations for Target Language Extraction. By adapting a pre-trained semantic speech model via language-aware prompt conditioning, we generated structured semantic priors that substantially enhance a time-domain extraction backbone. The resulting large speech model generates semantic tokens corresponding to a single language from a given mixture. These tokens are leveraged by a cross attention mechanism to guide the Target Language Extraction. The resulting 1.16 dB SI-SDR improvement shows that the simple extraction models predominantly rely on acoustic information and the novel approach is able to leverage the valuable semantic information for the extraction. Our ablation studies revealed a hierarchical conditioning mechanism. While categorical identity labels are essential for target disambiguation, semantic sequences provide the necessary structural guidance for high-fidelity reconstruction. In the future, we plan to extend these experiments to include other baseline architectures to show that the semantic information is beneficial irrespective of the underlying model architecture. We also aim to evaluate more typologically diverse language pairs and to quantify the inference cost introduced by the semantic model.
blocks.zh: 这部作品提出了一个新颖的框架,弥合了低音响信号处理与目标语言提取高级语义语音表述之间的差距. 通过通过语言意识的即时调制来改造一个预先训练的语义学语音模型,我们产生了结构化的语义学前科,大大增强了时间域提取骨干. 由此形成的大型语音模型产生语义符号,对应来自特定混合物的单一语言. 这些标志通过交叉关注机制加以利用,指导目标语言提取。 由此产生的1.16 dB SI-SDR改进表明,简单的提取模型主要依赖于声学信息,而新颖的方法能够利用宝贵的语义信息进行提取. 我们的消化研究揭示了一种分级调节机制. 虽然绝对身份标签对于目标混淆至关重要,但语义序列为高真性重建提供了必要的结构指导. 在未来,我们计划将这些实验扩展至包括其他基线架构,以表明语义信息不论背后的模型架构都是有益的. 我们还旨在评估更多类型多样的语言对子,量化语义模型引入的推论成本.
